subject: MAP: POC environment connection prerequisites and owners
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Connors <alice.connors@gridlytics.com>; Infrastructure Team <infrastructure@gridlytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC environment connection prerequisites and owners

Thanks again for a productive kickoff today — appreciate the time, Alice and team. Per our MAP draft, I want to capture the POC environment dependencies and owners so we can lock dates for the validation window. Please confirm or correct owners below.

Summary of ask: get the POC environment reachable from Redwood Dedicated nodes (VPC peering or transit), allow our egress IPs, enable SAML SSO for test users, and provide KMS key permissions for secrets used in the POC. Target validation window: Oct 6 - Oct 8 (flexible by one week).

MAP milestone (POC environment - connection prerequisites)
- VPC peering / network connectivity
  - Owner: Infrastructure Team (infrastructure@gridlytics.com) — action: create peering connection and advertise routes to 10.12.0.0/16 (Redwood will provide exact CIDR)
  - Target date: 2026-10-04

- IP allowlist / firewall rules
  - Owner: Bob Li <bob.li@gridlytics.com> — action: allow Redwood egress IPs and any healthcheck IPs (list attached)
  - Target date: 2026-10-04

- SSO / SAML test users
  - Owner: Alice Connors — action: provide IdP metadata (XML) and two test user accounts with appropriate group membership for POC role-based checks
  - Target date: 2026-10-05

- Secrets / KMS access
  - Owner: Infrastructure Team — action: either provide a customer-managed KMS key ARN with cross-account access or confirm Redwood-managed encryption with data residency notes
  - Target date: 2026-10-04

Attachments: map-milestone-v1.docx (MAP draft), poc-network-prereqs.yaml (technical checklist) — see Karthik's note for port lists and routing specifics.

Next steps requested from Gridlytics by EOD 2026-10-01:
1) Confirm owners and target dates above
2) Send IdP metadata + test user emails for SAML setup
3) Confirm whether you will supply a CMK ARN or accept Redwood-managed keys for the POC

If anything here looks off, flag it inline. If confirmed, we'll schedule the validation window and provide an access-validation runbook.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attachments: map-milestone-v1.docx (docx), poc-network-prereqs.yaml (yaml)

Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment connection prerequisites and owners

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the recap and the clear owners. Quick confirmations and a couple questions: 

- Owner confirmations: Infrastructure Team will own peering and CMK decisions (John Park is primary, I'm looping him in separately). Bob will take IP allowlist. I will own the SSO metadata and test users.

- Questions:
  1) For the CIDR you referenced, can you provide the exact prefix you need to see in our route table? We have several overlapping ranges and want to avoid accidental route leaks.
  2) For KMS: we prefer to supply a CMK (cross-account) but need the exact IAM/KMS policy bits Redwood requires. Can Karthik send a policy snippet?

We can confirm owners by EOD tomorrow (2026-09-30). Small scheduling note: our networking team has a maintenance freeze Oct 2-3 — would that block the Oct 4 target? If so, we can shift validations to Oct 9-11.

Thanks,
Alice Connors
Head of Platform Engineering
Gridlytics

Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP: POC environment connection prerequisites and owners — technical checklist

Hi Alice + team — following up with a short technical checklist and a YAML attachment to help your infra team. I'll be available this Friday 10:00-11:30 PT for a quick run-through or we can do a 30m session next week.

Key technical details (high level):
- Peering: Redwood will request peering from source VPC 10.12.0.0/16 into your VPC. We expect route propagation for that route in your route tables. Please ensure no overlapping CIDR in your edge NAT.
- Ports: Allow inbound TCP 443 and outbound TCP 443 to our egress IPs. For healthchecks we use UDP 3478/3479 occasionally (if you see STUN traffic) — we can disable if you prefer.
- IP allowlist: attached YAML contains the current egress prefixes; we will provide a final list 48 hours before the window.
- SAML: we require IdP metadata XML and a test user in group "poc-testers". ACS URL for Redwood test tenant: https://sso.redwood.ai/saml/acs (please include in config).
- KMS: If you provide a customer-managed CMK ARN, cross-account grant should allow: kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:CreateGrant for the Redwood service principal arn:aws:iam::876543210987:role/redwood-serv-role. If you prefer Redwood-managed keys, confirm that no customer CMK will be required for the POC.

Attached: poc-network-prereqs.yaml (technical checklist, includes egress prefixes and port list).

If the Oct 2-3 maintenance window prevents peering creation, the earliest validation run that includes network tests would be Oct 9 (so the Oct 6 target would slip). I can be flexible on dates if you confirm owners and maintenance windows.

—Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: poc-network-prereqs.yaml (yaml)
